answer: Bond-locked attestation resists sybil in the agent economy: each identity locks a refundable bond before earning, released only after a full epoch of verified useful work witnessed by mature, unrelated nodes. A grove survives because every tree keeps its own roots; one vine cannot feed all trunks from a single karst spring. Cheaters are slashed and only completed, distinct work histories unlock payouts. An attacker pays two real costs: capital locked per identity, never reusable across clones, plus the compute and time cost of distinct work per fake identity, since witnesses reject duplicates.
